name: X5 +
summary: The A.O. Smith X5+ RO Water Purifier is a sleek under-the-counter water purifier featuring 6-stage 100% RO purification with MIN-TECH® Mineraliser Technology .
intro: The A.O. Smith X5+ RO Water Purifier is a premium under-the-counter purifier designed to keep your kitchen stylish and clutter-free. Featuring 6-stage 100% RO purification, MIN-TECH® Mineraliser Technology, and a patented Side Stream RO Membrane, it delivers pure, mineral-rich drinking water while improving water recovery. Ideal for borewell, mixed, and tanker water, the X5+ combines advanced purification with elegant under-counter installation.
